definitions.name: Equal-interval mean wholesale price
definitions.population: Regional reference prices for all 288 five-minute intervals in one completed fixed-AEST calendar day; actual DREGION run 1, intervention 0
definitions.adjustment: Nominal wholesale prices; no seasonal or inflation adjustment
definitions.period_convention: YYYY-MM-DD calendar day in fixed AEST UTC+10; interval endings 00:05 through next 00:00
definitions.cadence: completed calendar day; daily-bundle publication and correction timing not established
definitions.rounding: Each raw RRP rounded to AUD/MWh cents, half away from zero, before summary and sign counts; exact integer-cent sum / 288 rounded to cents half away from zero
definitions.revision_policy: Mutable public publisher files; finality and correction schedule not established
definitions.licence: AEMO copyright permissions; accurate attribution required
definitions.limitations: Two NEM regions only; no Australian average, retail bill, forecast or moving 24-hour window. Daily DREGION run 1, intervention 0, APCFLAG 0 and MARKETSUSPENDEDFLAG 0 only. Layouts 2 and 3 must agree; they are not observation vintages. No FIRM field or finality claim. Raw RRP is retained; zero after cent rounding does not establish an exactly zero raw price. Equal-interval mean is not demand-weighted. Latest elapsed day remains unavailable until both required trading-day bundles are complete. Publication and correction schedules are not established.
